nodes.author: lpn1972
nodes.text: @CartlandDavid Metapneumovirus is not some new, super virus. It’s been around a while and is a viral infection very similar to a cold. Do everything you’d do for any other cold and it will pass. Immunocompromised folks should see the doctor for possible secondary infection that may need meds.
